column1: # config/units.tsv -- unit, address, size, state (match: in the gate; open: parked), flag class, source,
# optional entry symbol. A game unit is one original object, or the reading of one that the evidence and
# Above each game unit: "# premise:" names the joins inside it that rest on the RCS premise alone (every
# object from 0x8000BAA8 on opens its read-only data with an RCS run, which the project accepts: in every
# assignment of the RCS starts that meets it, no run lies where an object starting there would need one);
# "# guess:" the joins and the boundary before it that rest on the user's ruling (AGENTS.md, R15): where
# no evidence settles a position it is a join, the likelier reading, and where one of several read-only
# object starts must fall, the boundary goes at the candidate the remaining evidence favours (said on the
# line), the earliest if none; "# lineage:" a boundary that rests on the published source a unit descends
# from; "# open inside:" a position a unit holds on that lineage. ./wof unitmap reports evidence only and
# still lists every "# guess:" and lineage position as unknown. Every such position was tested with all
# of: the text padding (a 4-byte gap ends an object, a function ending off an 8-byte boundary with the
# next right after joins one); the read-only data (object starts at RCS runs and alignment zeros,
# bracketed and put in order; contiguous items; items in text order; one string literal used on both
# sides; one string at two addresses); the objects' static .bss (shared statics and their order); .data
# and .bss interleaving between two functions' private data; the order of the units' .data against their
# users; stale fill that ends an object's .data; the RCS premise; and the call graph (helpers called from
# one place, proc handlers named by their creator, function addresses in data), which fails at certain
# positions and so decides nothing alone. The order of the common .bss (uninitialised globals) was
# compared with the order of their first users and does not follow it.
# open inside: after amCreateAudioMgr: nothing in the image decides it; the unit holds it as the audiomgr.c of the SDK demos, one file
# lineage: boundary after __clearAudioDMA: nothing in the image decides it; the SDK demos' audiomgr.c ends there
